judgement.reason: Authentik is a single-image web app on PostgreSQL with a same-image worker, and the local storage it uses can be moved to S3 as a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./data:/data (lifecycle/container/compose.yml server), volume ./custom-templates:/templates (lifecycle/container/compose.yml server), volume ./data:/data (lifecycle/container/compose.yml worker), volume ./custom-templates:/templates (lifecycle/container/compose.yml worker)
reviews.reason: The shown files do not prove that the /data media directory and the /templates directory are moved to S3 or are otherwise unnecessary, so the vendor should confirm whether this local state is needed.
